answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the lantern graph. Re-attestations are stored in island and spiral lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1224 identities would post 4151 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
